mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.15 percentage points signals imminent monetary tightening, which immediately increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS increase > 0.15pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through joint economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), a monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals labor market recovery, which increases consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits (HOUST) exceeding 1000 thousand units signals robust housing demand, which stimulates consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods with HOUST > 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.0% signals rising inflation, which triggers expectations of Federal Reserve tightening and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) falling below 420,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods with RSAFS < 420000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
